constraints: period key: Tomokiyo's reconstruction of the Spinelli brothers' cipher (after Domnina 2015, Fig.1) is on disk as keys/key_spinelli_c1515.tsv (44 rows, 23 letter columns with q/x/z blank, 5 homophone pairs, 12 nulls, 6 word codes); applied shape-for-shape it covers 35% of the signs and fails a 200-shuffled-key unigram control (83/200 shuffles >= real; NOTES.md campaign step H4)

known answer: Tomokiyo reads the words 'la gubernation d'ispagnia' somewhere in this letter with that key (henryvii.htm, Jan 2024 note); not located by a crib search over three blind key-coded passes (H2, best 3/22)

design as measured: IC 0.0858 vs it16 Italian 0.0754 (H12) -- one over-merged symbol (HOOK, 22%) plus nulls make the text more repetitive than plain Italian; Sukhotin names no vowel code above the shuffled-order null

the three other 1519 Barcelona letters of Filza 163 (10844891, 10844888, 10844889) are digitised and carry no cipher (H19/H19b); the 86-letter Tommaso bundle online (17296147) covers 1492-1509 only (H20c); the enciphered years 1515-22 (b.126 ff.2571-87) are not online

locate Tomokiyo's crib on the montages by eye or with Domnina's Fig.1 once reachable (H6/H8), then calibrate
